# Before / after

## Promotional + significance
Before: Nestled in the heart of Worcestershire, the vibrant town of Evesham stands as a testament to the region's rich agricultural heritage, playing a pivotal role in the Vale's thriving horticulture sector.
After: Evesham is a market town in Worcestershire and the centre of the Vale of Evesham's fruit and vegetable growing.

## -ing tail + rule of three
Before: The team shipped the new search in March, improving speed, accuracy and user satisfaction, underscoring its commitment to innovation.
After: The team shipped the new search in March. Median query time fell from 900 ms to 220 ms.

## Negative parallelism
Before: This isn't just a cache layer — it's a complete rethink of how we serve content.
After: The cache layer serves article pages from memory, so the database is only hit on a miss.

## Vague attribution + hedging
Before: While detailed information is limited, experts widely regard the project as a significant step forward.
After: (Delete, or) The Guardian's 2026 review called it "the first workable model" for local news funding.

## Chat residue
Before: Certainly! Here's a concise summary of the release. I hope this helps!
After: (Start with the summary.)

## Overview
